breaking.change: A <tabs> element's parts are Tabs.track, Tabs.indicator (the mark that slides to the selected tab) and Tabs.tab[selected], the names the core default and og style new already dress; they were Segmented.track, Segmented.thumb and Segmented.item since og.ui.tabBar went, so every Tabs.tab dressing was ignored.
breaking.fix: Rename a style's Segmented.track, Segmented.thumb and Segmented.item[selected] selectors to Tabs::track, Tabs::indicator and Tabs::tab:selected.

fixed.summary: The state sheet's tabs move to the fields page, where a two-tab bar fits a phone cell by touch, and its disclosures sit in a panel as an accordion.
